text: The sea lamprey slaps the carp in the head with his tail, bruising the muscle!
The carp has been knocked unconscious!
The sea lamprey bites the carp in the head, bruising the muscle!
The sea lamprey latches on firmly!
The sea lamprey shakes the carp around by the head, tearing apart the head's scale and bruising the fat!
The carp passes out from exhaustion.
The carp gives in to pain.
The sea lamprey bites the carp in the head, bruising the fat!
